metadata.question: Does the location at coordinates 34.770153, -118.423217 (with a 300-meter radius) show a solar farm, rather than a water pond based on Landsat imagery from April 14, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point(34.770153, -118.423217) with 300m buffer - Date: April 14, 2020 (will use ±15 days for flexibility) - Collection: Landsat 8 OLI (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2) for 2020 2. Masking strategy: - Apply cloud masking to get clear pixels - For distinguishing solar farm vs water pond: * Solar farms: High reflectance in visible bands, moderate NDVI (not vegetation), low NDWI (not water) * Water ponds: Very low NIR reflectance, very high NDWI (>0.3), negative NDVI - Key indices: NDWI (water detection), NDVI (vegetation check), NIR reflectance 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - If no images found → C1 - If all pixels masked → C2 - If calculation returns None/NaN → C3 - Solar farm indicators: NDWI < 0, low NDVI (< 0.3), moderate-high visible reflectance - Water pond indicators: NDWI > 0.3, very low NIR - Answer A if solar farm characteristics, B if water pond characteristics ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.423217, 34.770153]); const roi = point.buffer(300); const targetDate = ee.Date('2020-04-14'); const dateRange = ee.DateRange(targetDate.advance(-15, 'day'), targetDate.advance(15, 'day')); // 2. Data Acquisition & Check let collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(dateRange.start(), dateRange.end()) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const colSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { // Try Landsat 9 as fallback collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(dateRange.start(), dateRange.end()) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const col9Size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 9 images found: ${col9Size}`); if (col9Size === 0) { console.log('No images found in date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing - Cloud masking and get closest image function maskL8sr(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); const saturationMask = image.select('QA_RADSAT').eq(0); const opticalBands = image.select('SR_B.').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); return image.addBands(opticalBands, null, true) .updateMask(qaMask) .updateMask(saturationMask); } const image = collection.map(maskL8sr) .sort('CLOUD_COVER') .first(); // Check valid pixels const countResult = image.select('SR_B4').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pixelCount = countResult.get('SR_B4').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels after masking: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation - Compute NDWI, NDVI, and reflectance values const nir = image.select('SR_B5'); const green = image.select('SR_B3'); const red = image.select('SR_B4'); const ndwi = green.subtract(nir).divide(green.add(nir)).rename('NDWI'); const ndvi = nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red)).rename('NDVI'); const stats = image.addBands([ndwi, ndvi]).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const ndwiVal = stats.get('NDWI').getInfo(); const ndviVal = stats.get('NDVI').getInfo(); const nirVal = stats.get('SR_B5').getInfo(); const redVal = stats.get('SR_B4').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`NDWI: ${ndwiVal !== null ? ndwiVal.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); console.log(`NDVI: ${ndviVal !== null ? ndviVal.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); console.log(`NIR: ${nirVal !== null ? nirVal.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); console.log(`Red: ${redVal !== null ? redVal.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); if (ndwiVal === null || ndviVal === null || nirVal === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Solar farm: Low NDWI (not water), moderate NDVI (not dense vegetation), reflective surface // Water pond: High NDWI (> 0.2), low NIR, negative or very low NDVI if (ndwiVal > 0.2) { console.log('High NDWI indicates water pond.'); console.log('B'); } else if (ndwiVal < 0 && ndviVal < 0.4 && nirVal > 0.1) { console.log('Low NDWI, moderate NDVI/NIR indicates solar farm.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Ambiguous - defaulting to water pond.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
